passages.p3:
Read the passage and then answer the questions
My name is Herman. I live in a big city in Germany and it's quite exciting! There are lots of things to do. My parents bought a flat near a park where I can ride my bike or go skateboarding. The city library is a great place. I usually meet my friends there and we do our school projects or study together. City life can be fast, tiring and stressful. The streets are always crowded and noisy. Because of the cars is polluted sometimes. People are so busy that they rarely have time for their neighbours or friends. But I love living in the city too much.
